## Summary

Describe the generic change, its tests, and any schema/deployment/rollback
impact.

## Disclosure checklist

- [ ] Every fixture, screenshot, identifier, URL, and example is fictional.
- [ ] No corporate data, private source layout/mapping, internal path/topology,
      credential, private migration knowledge, or private planning text is
      included.
- [ ] Package/archive/container contents were inspected when relevant.
- [ ] Lint, syntax, tests, browser checks, and disclosure scans are reported.
- [ ] Security, compatibility, backup, and rollback implications are explained.
